import json,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent.absolute()
cmd=['dotnet','build','CombatSolver.csproj','-c','Release','--no-restore','-p:CopyModOnBuild=false','-p:CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets='+str(p/'native.props'),'-p:OutputPath='+str(p/'build-native')+'/']
t=time.monotonic()
with (p/'build-native.log').open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(p/'build-native-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'exitCode':r.returncode,'wallSeconds':time.monotonic()-t},indent=2)+'\n')
print((p/'build-native.log').read_text()[-4000:])
if r.returncode==0:(p/'build-native'/'CombatSolver.json').write_bytes(Path('CombatSolver.json').read_bytes())
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
